_note: The Family app (was Hayati): partners, relatives, babies and nannies. Numbers are mirrored in supabase/migrations/*_family.sql and checked by scripts/check-life-config.mjs.

discovery._how: Each day, for every other partner your partner has that you don't know about, there's this chance you find out.

stages.label: Newborn
stages.text: Tiny, sleepy and always hungry. Lots of cuddles.

stages.label: Crawling
stages.text: On the move! Crawling everywhere and grabbing everything.

stages.label: First steps
stages.text: Took their first wobbly steps today. Have the camera ready!

stages.label: Running around
stages.text: Running around the house, laughing and exploring.

stages.label: First words
stages.text: Said their first words, and now they won't stop talking.

stages.label: Nursery
stages.text: Off to nursery: painting, songs and new friends.

stages.label: Big school
stages.text: First day at school with a brand-new bag.

stages.label: Growing up
stages.text: Football after school, homework, and big questions.

stages.label: Teenager
stages.text: A teenager now: headphones on, and taller than you think.
